mapper.select: SELECT p.*, sl.layer_name, sl.shelf_code, br.status AS borrow_status, br.borrower, br.production_line, br.checkout_time AS checkout_time_borrow FROM pad_info p LEFT JOIN shelf_layer sl ON p.shelf_layer_code = sl.layer_code LEFT JOIN pad_borrow_record br ON br.pad_id = p.id AND br.status = 'BORROWED' WHERE p.shelf_layer_code = #{layerCode} ORDER BY p.pad_code ASC

SELECT p.*, sl.layer_name, sl.shelf_code, br.status AS borrow_status, br.borrower, br.production_line, br.checkout_time AS checkout_time_borrow FROM pad_info p INNER JOIN shelf_layer sl ON p.shelf_layer_code = sl.layer_code LEFT JOIN pad_borrow_record br ON br.pad_id = p.id AND br.status = 'BORROWED' WHERE sl.shelf_code = #{shelfCode} ORDER BY sl.layer_code ASC, p.pad_code ASC
